tags.description: Built between 1907 and 1909, the lake is part of the watershed in the park, and drains to the Monongahela River. Until the 1970s boats could be rented. The boathouse was demolished in 1979. A full restoration of the lake is planned.
tags.name: Panther Hollow Lake

tags.description: This is the second Lake Elizabeth, built in the 1960s during Urban Renewal. The first was built in the late 1860s, and was larger. It was drained and used to store scrap metal during World War II.
